description: Cuphead Legacy (Studio MDHR, GOG 2017-09-29 v15295, via Proton)
long: Cuphead is a run-and-gun action game famous for its hand-drawn, 1930s rubber-hose cartoon art style and jazz soundtrack. Players battle through a series of challenging, pattern-heavy boss fights and run-and-gun levels to repay a debt to the Devil. It can be played solo or in local two-player cooperative mode.
